summary: Completed live managed-auth API and frontend regression testing. Login, dynamic Google redirect, callback error handling, protected routing, seeded session authentication, dashboard, all workspace routes, responsive login, logout, and production build passed.
critical_code_review_comments: The session exchange route performs synchronous requests.get inside an async FastAPI handler; use an async HTTP client or run the blocking call off the event loop before high-concurrency use.

Session exchange accepts an untyped dict and directly indexes provider fields (email/session_token); validate the provider response and return a controlled integration error instead of allowing malformed responses to become 500 errors.

success_rate.backend: 100% (2/2 live auth tests; unauthenticated negative checks also passed)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (login, callback, protected redirect, authenticated navigation, logout, responsive check, build)

seed_data_creation: Created and removed temporary TEST_auth_* records in the live-auth pytest fixture and TEST_ui_user/TEST_ui_token for the authenticated browser run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Managed Google provider identity exchange itself was not completed because no operator-supplied Google identity was available; invalid callback behavior and the server-side session contract were tested. No APIs are mocked by the app.
rca of the issue: No functional failures reproduced. The remaining review comments are preventative reliability/input-validation risks in /api/auth/session, not observed failures.
